answer: Require every agent to grow a trellis of verified work: each identity starts with a small stake and earns reputation only by completing checked tasks over time, like vines climbing a trellis. A prism of independent verifiers refracts each claim, checking the work, the stake, and the history separately, so a fake identity cannot pass on a single forged signal. Crossing the ridge to trusted status takes real cost and time, so a Sybil operator must pay that price for every copy while honest agents keep their earned standing.
